data.description: If wearer fails a save against an effect that causes him to become entangled, paralyzed, or slowed, he gets a second save; if he successful at the second saving throw, he gains the benefits of longstrider for 5 rounds. Crumbles after use. Up to 3 talismans may be worn at one time.
data.name: Talisman (Lesser/Triskelion)

raw_tokens.value: If wearer fails a save against an effect that causes him to become entangled, paralyzed, or slowed, he gets a second save; if he successful at the second saving throw, he gains the benefits of longstrider for 5 rounds. Crumbles after use. Up to 3 talismans may be worn at one time.
